items.source: exception - the exception thrown by the cache provider
items.translation: exception - 由缓存提供者抛出的异常

items.source:
Typically, failing to retrieve an object from the cache with
a given id can be transparently managed as a cache miss by not
throwing back such exception.
items.translation: 通常，无法从缓存中检索给定 id 的对象可以通过不抛出此类异常来透明地管理为缓存未命中。

items.source: Handle the given runtime exception thrown by the cache provider when clearing the specified Cache, possibly rethrowing it as a fatal exception.
items.translation: 处理缓存提供者在清除指定的Cache时抛出的运行时异常，并可能将其重新抛出为致命异常。

items.source: Handle the given runtime exception thrown by the cache provider when updating an item with the specified key and value, possibly rethrowing it as a fatal exception.
items.translation: 处理缓存提供者在更新具有指定 `key` 和 `value` 的项目时抛出的运行时异常，可能将其重新抛出为致命异常。

items.source: Handle the given runtime exception thrown by the cache provider when clearing an item with the specified key, possibly rethrowing it as a fatal exception.
items.translation: 处理缓存提供者在清除具有指定 `key` 的项目时抛出的运行时异常，可能将其重新抛出为致命异常。

items.source: Handle the given runtime exception thrown by the cache provider when retrieving an item with the specified key, possibly rethrowing it as a fatal exception.
items.translation: 处理缓存提供程序在检索具有指定 `key` 的项目时抛出的运行时异常，可能将其重新抛出为致命异常。

items.source: key - the key used to get the item
key - the key used to update the item
value - the value to associate with the key
key - the key used to clear the item
